name: gizza-ai/fuzzy-csv-join
summary: Join two CSVs with fuzzy key matching

tool.description: Join two CSV tables on approximately matching key values. Choose a similarity algorithm and threshold, emit SQL-style inner/left/right/outer joins, cap multiple candidate matches per left row, include match scores, and inspect unmatched rows or a JSON coverage report. Inputs are CSV text with header rows and all processing runs locally.

algorithm.description: Similarity algorithm. jaro_winkler (default) handles abbreviations well; levenshtein is edit-distance ratio; token_sort ignores word order; soundex is phonetic.

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter: a single character or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Default comma.

ignore_punctuation.description: Remove punctuation and symbols before scoring, so 'ACME, Inc.' and 'Acme Inc' compare closer. Default false.

join_type.description: Rows to keep in the joined CSV: inner matches only; left keeps all left rows; right keeps all right rows; outer keeps both sides.

left.description: Left CSV text. The first row is the header and data rows are matched against the right CSV.

left_key.description: Key column in the left CSV, as a header name or 1-based column index.

max_matches.description: Maximum right-side candidates emitted for each left row, best scores first. Default 1.

normalize_case.description: Compare keys case-insensitively by lowercasing before scoring. Default true.

output.description: Return the joined CSV, only unmatched left rows, only unmatched right rows, or a JSON report with matches and coverage stats.

right.description: Right CSV text. The first row is the header; matched rows are appended after the left columns.

right_key.description: Key column in the right CSV, as a header name or 1-based index. Blank reuses left_key's reference.

show_score.description: Append a match_score column to joined CSV output. Default true.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity score from 0 to 100, inclusive. Default 85.
